items.summary: Researchers have used AI to uncover the DNA signature of a key genetic “switch” involved in turning genes on. items.title: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
items.summary: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. items.title: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
items.summary: Scientists say the growing El Niño weather pattern is an "unprecedented event" and means 2027 is likely to be the world's hottest year on record.

items.title: Scientists discover a real-life “dragon” and name it after Syrax
items.summary: Scientists discovered a small, yellowish mountain horned dragon in Thailand and named it Acanthosaura syrax after a dragon from House of the Dragon. Found only in a narrow band of high-elevation forest, the distinctive new species could become a flagship for protecting its rare mountain habitat.

items.title: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
items.summary: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. Researchers analyzing 23 biological aging clocks found the lowest aging levels among people sleeping about 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day.
